fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation (TSM +14.09%) rose 14.5% on Nvidia CEO return news, with the Nasdaq Composite rising 6.9%.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC is the world's largest chip manufacturer and Nvidia's exclusive manufacturing partner, generating 19% of 2025 revenue from Nvidia.
fields.summary_ko.2: 68% of revenue comes from high-performance computing, maintaining reasonable valuation at P/E of 23.6.
